memory.read-range.description: Read a contiguous byte range and return a compact hex dump

memory.write.example: api memory.write cpu=A address=10A04A width=16 value=0051 expect=0011
memory.write.description: Debugger-safe write; pauses machine and reports old/new values

memory.trace.start.example: api memory.trace.start cpu=A address=0x100303 length=1 width=any limit=256
memory.trace.start.description: Start bounded generic memory-write tracing for an address or range; width filters the originating write transaction width, while range overlap determines address matches. Use width=any when tracing a byte that may be written by a wider transaction.

memory.trace.status.description: Read generic memory-write trace configuration, event count and limit

memory.trace.tail.description: Return recent matching generic memory-write events, including unchanged writes

memory.trace.stop.description: Stop generic memory-write tracing while retaining captured events

memory.trace.clear.description: Clear captured generic memory-write events and reset the trace write count

register.read.description: Read one register or complete CPU register set

register.write.description: Write a CPU register while paused

patch.freeze.example: api patch.freeze cpu=A address=10A04A width=16 value=0051
patch.freeze.description: Immediately write and continuously freeze a value; returns patch ID

patch.replace.example: api patch.replace cpu=A address=10A04A width=16 value=0051
patch.replace.description: Replace matching game writes with a fixed value

patch.suppress.description: Suppress writes and preserve current value

memory.export.example: api memory.export cpu=A address=109000 length=512 output=evidence\\stage1-track-109000.bin
memory.export.description: Export a contiguous debugger-safe byte range under the evidence root

control.run-frames.description: Run exactly N emulated frames and pause; cancellation-aware with configurable progress-aware timeout

control.abort.description: Out-of-band pause/cancel of active frame execution

checkpoint.save.description: Save current deterministic state into packaged checkpoints and write metadata

frame.snapshot.description: Capture reconstructable layered frame snapshot with exact aggregate alpha contribution layers, raw sources, HUD variants, scene-no-sprites base, cropped per-visible-sprite forensic assets/metadata, palette state and manifest

frame.snapshot.assert-overlap.example: api frame.snapshot.assert-overlap name=normal front=82 back=81 frontSolo=body backSolo=shadow
frame.snapshot.assert-overlap.description: Assert non-vacuous front ownership, uncovered back visibility, overlap coverage and exact per-sprite coordinates against solo runtime source renders; throws on mismatch

params: require=NAME optional; throw unless exactly one snapshot named NAME is present in the returned list
frame.snapshot.list.description: List structured frame snapshots, optionally asserting that a named snapshot is immediately discoverable

regions.list.description: Return authoritative image regions as structured JSON

profiles.list.description: List packaged game-profile descriptors; metadata only and does not switch runtime

profile.get.description: Read one packaged game profile and whether it is active/activatable

sprites.list.description: Return current live composed sprite records as structured JSON

sprites.maps.description: Return unique live sprite map IDs

sprites.palettes.description: Return unique live sprite palette IDs

sprite.inspect.description: Inspect one currently active sprite slot

params: map=N optional; resolves all currently active matching slots
sprite.map.inspect.description: Inspect raw spritemap/chunk provenance and raw pen histogram for an active sprite slot or all active slots using a requested map.

schema.all.description: Return every Script API action contract from the authoritative in-process schema

script.schema.description: Return the authoritative Research Script v2 grammar and limits

params: message=TEXT required; underscores render as spaces
ui.prompt.description: Show an SDL-native prompt overlay and wait for Enter/Escape while physical gameplay keys remain live

sprite.override.description: Presentation-only live SDL sprite override; omitted fields retain original values

sprite.override.clear.description: Clear all live sprite presentation overrides

palette.entries.description: Return the 16 palette entry indices for a bank

state.snapshot.description: Capture coherent structured research state from the current paused instant

control.step-frame.description: Advance paused emulation by N frames

timer.hold.description: Freeze or resume the game timer helper

tuning.handling.get.description: Read handling override plus instruction-time turn/table/speed/lateral coefficient telemetry when valid

collision.state.description: Read evidence-scoped collision-response suppression state and counters; detection remains live

collision.response.get.description: Read whether authentic collision response writes are enabled

collision.response.set.description: Enable/disable only proven collision response writes while preserving detection/event logic

input.steering.get.description: Read raw IOC steering injection (signed 12-bit encoding, centre=0000)

input.steering.set.description: Set raw IOC steering injection; use 0000 centre, 0060 right, 0FA0 left for proven full steering

palette.entry.restore.description: Return one palette entry to game control

input.ioc.pulse.description: Pulse IOC mask for emulated frames

input.ioc.sweep.description: Run deterministic IOC mask sweep and collect evidence

logs.tail.description: Tail a log using the exact identifier returned by logs.list

evidence.zip.description: Create ZIP for one evidence capture

image.compare.example: api image.compare a=control b=test region=PLAYER_CAR hud=hidden
image.compare.description: Compare two captures/snapshots and return pixel-difference metrics; HUD modes require layered snapshots

image.diff.example: api image.diff a=control b=test region=FULL hud=hidden output=diff
image.diff.description: Compare images and optionally save a grayscale diff PNG; HUD modes require layered snapshots

next-steps.description: Return packaged high-level research next steps

experiment.begin.description: Start a grouped research experiment/evidence manifest

experiment.capture.description: Capture screenshot plus structured state into the active experiment

experiment.status.description: Return the active experiment manifest or inactive state

experiment.end.description: Finalize and close the active experiment manifest

platform.info.description: Return build, script engine, active profile and research-platform identity

script.functions.description: List supported Script Console query/collection functions

registry.list.description: Return gameplay registry items as a flat structured list

track.records.description: Read track records around the current authoritative record

objects.list.description: Return semantic-object registry candidates and evidence confidence

audio.capabilities.description: Describe planned/current audio research capabilities without mutating audio runtime

audio.channels.description: Return audio channel/source descriptors from the audio research profile

audio.events.description: Return current audio-event foundation status; runtime capture is intentionally not enabled yet

audio.waveform.plan.description: Return waveform-viewer/capture implementation contract for future validated audio tooling

audio.export.plan.description: Return planned sample/music export contract and evidence formats

audio.inject.plan.description: Return guarded runtime audio-injection design; does not inject audio

schema.description: Describe scriptable API actions and parameter contracts

palette.trace.start.description: Start bounded semantic TC0110PCR write tracing for selected palette entries; captures frame, CPU, PC, old/new value and write count

palette.trace.status.description: Read palette trace enabled state, selected indices, event count and limit

palette.trace.tail.description: Return recent matching palette-write events including frame, CPU, PC, index/bank/pen, old/new value, changed flag and write count

palette.trace.stop.description: Stop palette-write capture while retaining captured events

palette.trace.clear.description: Clear captured palette-write events without changing the selected trace filter

track.record.start.description: Enable the shared server-side Track View recorder; browser UI and scripts operate on the same recorder state

track.record.stop.description: Disable track recording while retaining collected samples

track.record.clear.description: Clear all shared track recorder samples

track.record.status.description: Return recorder enabled state, sample/segment counts, frame range and spatial bounds

track.record.sample.description: Append one deterministic authoritative track.state sample to the shared recorder

track.svg.export.description: Export shared recorded track samples to a genuine SVG under evidence/track-exports; refuses empty recordings

window.status.description: Read live SDL window state including fullscreen, visibility, minimized state, scale and always-on-top

window.scale.description: Set SDL integer window scale; exits fullscreen

docs.handover.description: Return authoritative ChatGPT continuation handover prompt

docs.export.description: Export documentation from authoritative knowledge source

docs.handbook.description: Return the complete user-facing handbook navigation and authored guide content

docs.page.description: Return one authored handbook page and its parent section

script.runs.description: List bounded authoritative script-run history with status/version/session filters and currentSession metadata for active-session UI defaults.

timeline.record.start.description: Start Forensic Timeline v1 capture in the current run; captures the current frame immediately, every subsequent emulated frame as CHQSTATE, and every bus write with PC/old/new provenance.

timeline.record.stop.description: Stop/finalize the active Forensic Timeline recording.

timeline.list.description: List discoverable timelines from the active run, completed runs and packaged research timelines.

timeline.load.description: Import a timeline and load its first frame into the paused emulator inspection surface; ordinary memory/register/sprite/palette/gameplay APIs inspect the selected recorded frame.

timeline.seek.description: Seek an imported timeline to an exact recorded frame.

timeline.next.description: Seek to the next recorded frame.

timeline.prev.description: Seek to the previous recorded frame.

timeline.frames.description: Return recorded frame numbers for the imported timeline.

timeline.trim.event.example: api timeline.trim.event name=turbo-complete-cycle cpu=A address=0x10040F width=8 mask=02 pre=1 post=1
timeline.trim.event.description: Find a masked rising/falling event window with a streaming pass and write a non-destructive analysis/event-window.json view; the authoritative timeline is not trimmed or rewritten.

timeline.scan.memory.example: api timeline.scan.memory name=turbo-complete-cycle triggerFrame=2065 stopFrame=2275 window=1
timeline.scan.memory.description: Streaming offline analysis of the recorded bus-write stream; exports ranked changed-address/writer-PC evidence into the current run artifact tree so the source timeline remains immutable and the result travels in the run bundle.

timeline.fork-live.description: Leave timeline mode while keeping the selected checkpoint loaded, producing a paused live fork for counterfactual experiments.

timeline.unload.description: Exit timeline mode and restore the live state from before timeline.load.

params: name=NAME or path=PATH optional when a timeline is already loaded
timeline.play.example: api timeline.play name=turbo-complete-cycle from=2064 to=2276 fps=30
timeline.play.description: Replay recorded frame checkpoints through the SDL renderer at a paced frame rate. This is visual state playback, not CPU re-execution; the timeline remains loaded at the final frame.

timeline.analyze.auto.example: api timeline.analyze.auto name=turbo-complete-cycle triggerFrame=2065 stopFrame=2275 window=1 top=20
timeline.analyze.auto.description: Run the automated offline forensic pipeline: portable current-run memory analysis, ranked temporal candidates, writer-PC grouping/disassembly, milestone state and structured frame snapshots, and HUD_TURBO graphics correlation.

game.experiment.status.description: Read Chase H.Q.-specific Game Lab state including target remaining-hit counter, one-hit target mode, turbo/current speed and reversible override toggles

game.turbo.stock.description: Enable/disable an infinite turbo-stock freeze on confirmed CPU-A 0x1003A2

game.turbo.active.description: Enable/disable infinite active turbo by freezing confirmed duration timer CPU-A 0x100414 at zero; activation still uses the normal turbo path

game.turbo.fire.description: Pulse the confirmed IOC P3 turbo input (mask 0x01)

game.turbo.timer.reset.description: Reset the confirmed turbo duration timer at CPU-A 0x100414 to zero

game.turbo.remaining.set.description: Set the confirmed turbos-remaining value at CPU-A 0x1003A2 once

game.speed.set.description: Set raw internal/physics speed CPU-A 0x10041C once while preserving prior run/pause state. HUD speed at 0x100400 is separate packed-BCD display state.

params: value=0..65535 optional; current internal speed used when omitted
game.speed.freeze.description: Freeze/unfreeze raw internal/physics speed CPU-A 0x10041C while preserving prior run/pause state.

game.speed.clear.description: Remove only the Game Lab current-speed freeze, leaving unrelated research patches untouched

tile.inspect.description: Inspect/export a TC0100SCN RAM text character as raw 2bpp pens, palette-aware PNG and JSON metadata; output names include the current frame to preserve historical phases.

sprite.order.inspect.description: Report exact current sprite traversal/tie-break and resolved active draw order.

sprite.order.set.description: Reversibly switch same-priority sprite tie-breaking at runtime for compositor A/B experiments.

game.sprite.order.inspect.description: Game Lab alias for current sprite-order report.

game.sprite.order.set.description: Game Lab alias for reversible same-priority sprite-order experiment.

timeline.reset.description: Idempotent cleanup for script-initiated timeline work: restore the live state captured before timeline.load even after timeline.fork-live; succeed unchanged when no timeline transaction is active.

layer.offsets.get.description: Read live presentation offsets for all five layers

layer.offsets.set.description: Set reversible live presentation offsets; hardware state is unchanged

tc0100.mode.description: Select diagnostic old/new X transform; this is not independent shadow verification

frame.snapshot.assert-scene-no-sprites.description: Require exact reconstruction, visible sprite ownership and changed no-sprites pixels

layer.offsets.assert.description: Assert live layer offsets against expected values

release.assert-version.description: Require native status, Workbench and feature manifest to share the full release label

frame.snapshot.assert-exact.description: Require exact=true, verifiedExact=true and zero reconstruction mismatches

game.target.one-hit.description: Enable/disable the Stage 1 special-target one-hit research cheat. When enabled, the confirmed 0x1002AE counter is armed to zero immediately before authentic damage PC 0xA112 so the genuine terminal underflow/defeat path executes.

course.follow.status.description: Read live autonomous course-follower configuration and closed-loop telemetry without restarting the emulator.

course.follow.configure.example: api course.follow.configure controller=hybrid lookahead=8 bias=0 speedControl=true
course.follow.configure.description: Configure the existing native course follower live. Bias is a signed target offset from geometric road centre for controlled branch mapping.

course.follow.start.description: Enable native closed-loop course following live without process restart.

course.follow.stop.description: Disable live course following and return injected steering to centre.

course.follow.reset.description: Reset follower derivative/output history and centred injected steering.

course.survey.status.description: Read Workbench live survey orchestration state, follower telemetry and shared recorder status.

course.survey.start.description: Start reversible live course survey: follower on, shared recorder cleared/started, optional timer hold and proven collision-response suppression.

course.survey.stop.description: Stop survey/recorder and restore timer, collision response and pre-existing follower enabled state.

track.map.export.description: Export v2 course-mapping dataset: master JSON, track samples, player trajectory, entity evidence, raw surface signatures and SVG.
